subject: Literature
title: Tolkien's Mythmaking
description: Learn Tolkien's Mythmaking in one minute.

hook.text: Tolkien believed England lacked a proper mythology, so he spent his life creating one from scratch.

buildup.text: The Silmarillion describes the creation of Middle-earth, its gods, and thousands of years of mythic history.

discovery.text: Tolkien drew on Norse, Finnish, and Celtic mythology but synthesized them into something entirely original.

twist.text: He considered The Lord of the Rings a small chapter within his larger mythology, not the central story.

climax.text: Tolkien proved that a modern author could create a mythology as rich and coherent as any ancient tradition.

punchline.text: One man built a mythology that rivals the ancients.

quiz.question: Why did Tolkien create the mythology of Middle-earth?
options: He wanted to write children's bedtime stories
He believed England lacked a proper mythology
He was commissioned by a publisher
